name: gh-extension-atlas
description: Curated field guide to GitHub CLI extensions.

scripts.catalog:recommend:check: node scripts/recommend.mjs --list > /dev/null && node scripts/recommend.mjs --workflow actions > /dev/null && node scripts/recommend.mjs --workflow notifications --format install > /dev/null && node scripts/recommend.mjs --workflow security --format json > /dev/null
scripts.catalog:compare:check: node scripts/compare-catalog.mjs gh-dash gh-notify > /dev/null && node scripts/compare-catalog.mjs dlvhdr/gh-enhance fchimpan/gh-workflow-stats --format json > /dev/null && node scripts/compare-catalog.mjs gh-poi gh-branch --format install > /dev/null
scripts.catalog:audit-installed:check: node scripts/audit-installed.mjs --demo > /dev/null && node scripts/audit-installed.mjs --demo --format json > /dev/null && node scripts/audit-installed.mjs --demo --format install > /dev/null
scripts.test: npm run validate:data && npm run catalog:recommend:check && npm run catalog:compare:check && npm run catalog:audit-installed:check && npm run site:check && npm run check:links && npm run lint:awesome
